annotations.title: Monitor a competitor URL for page changes

description: Start monitoring one competitor page for changes: title/meta, a real line-level content diff (added/removed/unchanged line counts — never a fabricated similarity score), outbound links, and structured-data types. Checked once a day; the first snapshot is captured on the NEXT scheduled pass, not immediately. FREE — this codebase's own SSRF-safe fetch, no paid provider. Idempotent (re-adding an already-tracked URL is a no-op). A project can monitor at most 20 URLs.

label.description: Optional human-readable label, e.g. 'Acme pricing page'.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

url.description: The specific competitor page URL to monitor — not a domain to crawl. Normalised and SSRF-validated server-side; a URL resolving to a private/loopback/metadata address is rejected.

name: add_competitor_monitor
